study type: Cohort study (secondary analysis of RCT data)
exposure: maternal antibiotic exposure during the last trimester of pregnancy
cessation of breastfeeding by 6 months of age
outcome: antibiotic exposure in the first 2 years of life
cohort: The study included 1201 participants from the MIS BAIR randomized controlled trial, assessing antibiotic exposure in the first 2 years of life.
finding: At least two-thirds of Australian children were prescribed antibiotics in the first 2 years of life, and more than a quarter of these exposures were identified as potentially unnecessary.
mod_finding: Delivery by Caesarean section was significantly associated with antibiotic exposure from 0 to 12 months of age (aOR 1.5, 95%CI 1.1-1.9).
